facts.text: There were 17,027 failed card attempts in August 2026 across all issuers.
Harbor Bank had the most failed card attempts: 3,489, or 20.5% of the total.
Lotus Bank was second with 3,206 failed attempts (18.8%), and Ridge Bank third with 2,782 (16.3%).
The top three issuers together account for 55.7% of all failed card attempts.
The remaining ranked issuers were Indigo Bank (2,598; 15.3%), Coral Bank (2,558; 15.0%) and Banyan Bank (2,004; 11.8%).
390 failed attempts (2.3%) have no issuer name and appear as a '(missing)' issuer.
